input.summary: Make embedded-IP licence irrevocable and extend to affiliates and contractors
input.comment: [Playbook] The licence to Contractor Information embedded in the Works must be irrevocable and must cover our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, and transfer to a successor; otherwise the Works we paid for cannot be used across our group.

ops.oldText: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
ops.newText: Contractor hereby grants to Company and its affiliates and contractors acting on Company's behalf a royalty-free, non- exclusive, worldwide, perpetual and irrevocable license (including the right to grant a sublicense, and transferable to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.

input.summary: Add conformity warranty with remedy and protect it from the disclaimer
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 gives us authority, legal-compliance and non-infringement warranties but no warranty that the Works conform to the Specifications and no remedy, so the disclaimer in 5(e) leaves us without recourse for defective work. We have added a 90-day conformity warranty (12 months for software is our preference) with re-performance, repair or refund.

ops.text: Contractor further represents and warrants that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery (twelve (12) months in the case of software), each Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation; and (iii) the Works will contain no viruses or other malicious code. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or Works.
